name: Schema Lineage Composite Evaluation (SLiCE)
description: SLiCE is a comprehensive metric and benchmark designed to evaluate automated schema lineage extraction from multilingual enterprise scripts, focusing on structural correctness and semantic fidelity. It includes a benchmark of 1,700 manually annotated lineages from real-world industrial scripts and assesses language models' ability to extract schema lineage components such as source schemas, tables, transformation logic, and aggregation operations.
reputation: A very new, domain-specific benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly relevant to data engineering and schema-lineage extraction research.
notes: Benchmark includes 1,700 manually annotated lineages; evaluates 12 language models including GPT-4o/4.1; focuses on schema lineage extraction in multilingual enterprise scripts.
